capability_role_test_data_requirement.policy: For every capability, provision an isolated persona matching its source role, an isolated tenant namespace, deterministic domain records required by the capability, and a redacted evidence reference. No shared production identity, fixture-only substitute, fixed percentage, fake signature, or fake delivery may satisfy a live gate. Capabilities requiring live/device/provider evidence additionally require an authorized resource ID, account/tenant ownership, readback command, candidate SHA, and captured receipt. Missing any item remains missing.
